name: TELEFONICA BRASIL S.A.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: Brazil's largest wireless carrier (about 33% market share, postpaid leadership) with scale, spectrum, the Vivo brand and a large FTTH footprint enabling converged cross-sell, backed by the Telefónica group — against strong Claro/TIM competition, low prepaid switching costs, heavy 5G/FTTH capex intensity, Anatel regulation including the FISTEL fee overhang, BRL/USD exposure on a USD-priced ADS, and minority holders subordinate to the controlling parent.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency BRL converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x2.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed February 23, 2026), notes to the consolidated financial statements describing the 2025 reverse stock split / stock split transaction: '1 ADR now representing 2 ordinary shares issued by the Company, while the total number of ADRs in circulation remained unchanged.') so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

SHARE_SCALE_SUSPECT: base OE/share 2,068.56 is 167x the price 12.40 (limit 20x); the declared base_override pin 1.26923 carries the base; market cap uses the latest diluted count as filed (the cover-page count agrees with it within 25%; no power-of-ten factor found in the dei count or the pin); the share-count series breaks scale inside the growth window (FY2022 3,223,658,000 -> FY2023 1,658,604, FY2024 1,643,132 -> FY2025 3,223,658,000), so the share-count CAGR (+0.0%/yr) and the OE/share CAGR (-97.7%/yr) were dropped from the growth blend (share adjustment 0)

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F FY2025 (accession 0002070979-26-000018), Note 24.h Earnings per share, p. F-89: Weighted average of common shares outstanding (in thousands) 3,223,658 — denominator of Basic and diluted results per common share R$1.91; the note states no potentially dilutive shares); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 1.27 vs 3-yr median 2068.56 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier C (11.3%) vs bull-case tier B (17.4%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Brazil's telecom incumbent, moat 5/10 — a 10.24% OE yield and +7.6% BRL revenue prints, but at $12.40 the weighted IRR is only 14.34% (bear 11.32%, bull 17.43%; IV@15% $11.72/ADS on a pinned FY2025 base of $1.27/ADS); it clears the 15% hurdle only at or below $11.72.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Largest Brazilian wireless carrier — about 33% market share with postpaid leadership (about 37% of postpaid)
Scale, spectrum holdings and the Vivo brand; record mobile ARPU in Q2 2026 prints
Extensive FTTH network enabling converged fixed-mobile cross-sell into its mobile base
Telefónica group parentage — technology, procurement and balance-sheet backing
moat_against: Claro (América Móvil) and TIM compete hard on price and network; prepaid switching costs are low
Capex intensity is structural (capex 16.4% of revenue in Q2 2026) — 5G and FTTH build never stops
Regulatory overhang: Anatel oversight and FISTEL TFF fees (the Q2 2026 release notes R$7.3B for 2020-2026 excluded from its debt figure)
BRL earnings priced in USD — real depreciation directly cuts per-ADS owner's earnings
Controlled company (Telefónica held 77.13% at Q1 2026) — minorities are subordinate to group strategy and a >=100%-of-net-income distribution commitment

overrides.source: Form 20-F FY2025 (accession 0002070979-26-000018), Note 24.h Earnings per share, p. F-89: Weighted average of common shares outstanding (in thousands) 3,223,658 — denominator of Basic and diluted results per common share R$1.91; the note states no potentially dilutive shares
